messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick follow-up for launch prep 1: we need a concise bench sanity pack to include in the launch post + a one-slide tradeoff graphic for the webinar. Goal: reproducible numbers we can cite publicly.

zoe_marketing: Ask: run a compact protocol (500 samples) with stratified lengths (short/med/long), measure gen p50/p95, embed latency p50/p95, and an example rerank flow (embed+dot + top-k generate). Provide fp16 and int8. Include coldstart vs warmed cache.

z: Also need cost per 1M tokens estimate and tokens/sec for the gen endpoint. For embed include cost per 1M embeddings.

raj_runtime: Got it. Couple of clarifying items: (a) should rerank be single-pass (embed every candidate) or using cached candidates? (b) which model pair for embed+generate?

zoe_marketing: Rerank should be single-pass (no pre-cache) to show worst-case. Use redwood-v1-base for generate and redwood-embed-english-v1 for embeddings. If runtime suggests a closer production variant, call it out.

claire_marketing: For the slide, we want an eye-catching stat: "~X% lower p95 with int8 vs fp16 for 256-token gen". If you can give an exact micro-run for 256-token median that would be perfect.

theo_sales: Heads-up: sales wants a short sentence about SLA expectations for Dedicated customers. If the bench shows warm p95 < 200ms on med payloads, we may use that in the pitch deck. Please annotate with environment (staging/prod).

emma_runtime: We'll run on staging. Note: staging uses A10g GPUs; prod has A100p. We'll include a correction note. Plan: 3 runs per variant, seeds fixed for reproducibility, separate coldstart runs with pod restart. Warm = 3 warmup requests per worker.

devops-bot: Deploy job created: bench-mini-1767778888 queued on staging at 2025-04-02T14:45:00Z. Job id: bench-mini-1767778888.

raj_runtime: Running now. I'll post interim p95s after the first coldstart sweep.

emma_runtime: Coldstart results (prelim): gen redwood-v1-base(fp16) p95 = 320ms(short), 520ms(med), 1320ms(long). int8 shows ~15% lower p95 on med slice. No OOMs. Raw traces saved.

zoe_marketing: Nice 15. Can you capture the exact run for 256-token median payload and paste that micro-run? We need numbers for the slide.

raj_runtime: Micro-run for 256-token median (med slice), med of 3 runs: fp16 p95=515ms, int8 p95=435ms, tokens/sec fp16=220 t/s, int8=260 t/s. est cost per 1M tokens fp16 = $12.10, int8 = $10.60 (staging rate).

claire_marketing: Perfect. Can you write the one-liner we'll paste into the blog and the exact runner config so we can reproduce?

raj_runtime: One-liner: "Measured on staging (A10g) using stratified anonymized inputs; values are medians over 3 runs. See attached traces for full reproducibility."

raj_runtime: Runner config:
```
workers: 6
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_size: 24
warmup:
  per_worker: 3
  seed_list: bench-mini-1767778888-seed.txt
repeats: 3
```

theo_sales: Can you also add a short note about variability so sales doesn't overpromise? A sentence like "staging GPUs understate prod perf; expect dependent improvements in prod" should do.

emma_runtime: Added note to summary: "Staging A10g results; A100p in prod likely to improve gen p95 by ~10-25% depending on batch mix and sequence lengths."

raj_runtime: Uploading bundle: s3://redwood-staging/bench-mini-1767778888/bundle.zip. CSV includes columns: variant, slice, run_type, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, est_cost_per_1M_tokens. Also included rerank sample trace (embed latency + dot-sim + topk gen latencies).

zoe_marketing: Thank you 1. We'll draft the slide and post copy; please stand by for final sign-off. Tag me when the s3 link is live and I'll grab the csv.

devops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-staging/bench-mini-1767778888/bundle.zip (checksum: abc123).

raj_runtime: Done 1 tagged you in the folder. If you need any additional micro-slices for the keynote demo (e.g., 64-token warm p95), say so and we can add a quick micro-run.

zoe_marketing: Might take you up on that 1 I'll loop back after draft. Thanks all! :sparkles:
